question: nq question: who won latest america's next top model

spans.text: The winner of the competition was 20 year-old Kyla Coleman from Lacey, Washington with Jeana Turner placing as the runner-up.
The twenty-fourth and final cycle of America's Next Top Model premiered on January 9, 2018.
